Enhanced DynUNet for Brain Tumor Segmentation Introduction This repository contains the implementation of the Enhanced DynUNet architecture, which integrates the Duck3D Block for improved brain tumor segmentation. Our method has been validated on the BraTS 2018 dataset, demonstrating superior performance in segmenting Whole Tumor (WT), Tumor Core (TC), and Enhancing Tumor (ET). Highlights - **State-of-the-art Performance**: Achieves higher Dice scores compared to existing models. - **Innovative Architecture**: Incorporation of the Duck3D Block enhances feature extraction capabilities. - **Clinical Relevance**: Provides a reliable tool for aiding in the diagnosis and treatment planning of brain tumors.
